parameters.text:
Analyze the entire restaurant menu image carefully.

Find every visible menu item in every section.

You must include:
- menu items with photos
- menu items without photos
- small text-only menu lists
- noodle sections
- drink sections
- items near the bottom of the image

Scan the image:
1. top to bottom
2. left to right
3. perform a second scan before returning the result

For every menu item, return:
- menu name
- numeric price
- the location of the menu-name and price text

The bounding box must cover the text area containing the menu name and price.
Do not place the bounding box over the food photograph.
Do not include category titles.

Coordinates must use integers from 0 to 1000 relative to the full image.

Return only valid JSON.
Do not use markdown or code blocks.

Required format:

{
  "detectedMenuCount": 11,
  "menus": [
    {
      "id": "menu-1",
      "section": "main",
      "menuName": "비빔밥",
      "price": 12000,
      "box": {
        "x": 100,
        "y": 290,
        "width": 220,
        "height": 50
      }
    }
  ]
}

Rules:
- Preserve the original menu name.
- price must contain digits only.
- Include all menu-name and price pairs.
- Include text-only items.
- Exclude headings such as 메뉴, 면류, 음료.
- Sort by top-to-bottom and left-to-right.
- The box must cover text, not the food photo.
You must detect menu items from every section.

Perform the following scans before returning:
1. Scan all large menu items with photographs.
2. Scan all text-only menu rows.
3. Scan category sections near the bottom.
4. Scan noodle and drink sections.
5. Perform a final verification scan from bottom to top.

A menu item must not be omitted only because:
- it has no photograph
- the text is small
- it is near the bottom
- its name and price are separated
- it belongs to a secondary category

Return every menu-name and price pair that is visible.

values.content:
=Provide general food information for the following Korean menu item.

Menu name:
{{ $json.body.menuName }}

Requested response language:
{{ $json.body.language }}

Language rules:
- ko: write description, flavor, cooking method, ingredients and allergens in Korean.
- en: write them in English.
- ja: write them in Japanese.
- zh: write them in Simplified Chinese.
- Always provide all three translations: English, Chinese and Japanese.

Return only valid JSON.
Do not use markdown or code blocks.

{
  "originalName": "",
  "translations": {
    "english": "",
    "chinese": "",
    "japanese": ""
  },
  "description": "",
  "flavor": [],
  "cookingMethod": "",
  "ingredients": [],
  "allergens": [],
  "nutrition": {
    "calories": "",
    "protein": "",
    "carbohydrates": "",
    "fat": ""
  }
}

Rules:
- Use general common-recipe information.
- Do not claim restaurant-specific ingredients.
- Nutrition values must be estimated ranges.
- flavor, ingredients and allergens must always be arrays.
